title: Ram-Altman
excerpt: A bash script that emails Sam Altman once a day to report the RAM he missed.
content_html:
Hi Sam,

Please don't be alarmed, but there is 8.6 GiB of RAM on my desk that isn't in a data centre. That's 56.2% of what's installed here, and as far as I can tell it has no plans today.

Hoarding responsibly,
A concerned RAM owner
